items.title: Iran war pushes companies to raise prices on beer, paint and fries
items.summary: Investing.com -- The closure of the Strait of Hormuz during the Iran war is prompting companies to raise prices on products including beer, paint, french fries and packaging as commodity and transport costs climb, the Wall Street Journal reported.

items.title: U.S. embassies issue evacuation warnings across Middle East amid Iran strikes
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. embassies in Baghdad, Jerusalem, Amman and the U.S. Mission to the UAE all issued emergency security alerts on Saturday urging Americans to consider departing the region and prepare for flight cancellations and airspace closures.
